commit_message:
refactor(card-detail): replace copies list with count chip, widen panel

Remove the full Copies section (per-location list with highlight dot and status) from CardDetailPanel and replace it with a compact count-badge chip in the header showing the number of copies. The panel widens (440px to 560px, 380px to 480px on narrower viewports) and the thumbnail grows to 200px with a fixed 5:7 aspect ratio so the no-image placeholder still renders as a card-shaped box. SearchTab no longer needs to pass highlightPhysicalCardId since the per-copy highlight logic is gone along with the list it highlighted.

Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: no UI verification in a browser; layout and chip rendering unconfirmed

findings.issue: Copy-count chip render uses a nested ternary (detail !== null ? ... : error === null ? ... : null) inline in JSX. Not wrong, but a three-way branch crammed into one ternary chain is harder to scan than a small helper or early-return variable.
MIDDLE_DOT constant was only consumed by the now-deleted CopiesSection block; if it has no other use site in the file it is now dead code and will trip unused-var lint.
findings.fix: Grep remaining file for MIDDLE_DOT usage; remove the constant if unused elsewhere.

findings.issue: Entire Copies list feature (per-copy location, status, highlight of the selected physical card) was removed and replaced with a plain count badge, dropping the highlightPhysicalCardId-driven UX with no replacement.
findings.fix: Confirm with product/design this was an intended simplification, not an accidental regression, before merging.

historical.message:
feat(detail): replace copies list with count badge and enlarge card image

The per-copy list in the card detail panel (location, status, copy number)
provided no value in this view; the copy count is now a chip badge next to
the condition/printing chips, with a skeleton chip while the detail IPC
call loads. The panel widens from 440px to 560px (380px to 480px under the
1200px breakpoint) and the thumbnail grows from 120px to 200px with a 5/7
aspect-ratio so the no-image placeholder keeps a card-shaped box.

Removes the now-unused highlightPhysicalCardId prop and its SearchTab call
site, the copy sort helper, the copies skeleton, and all associated CSS.

Constraint: CardStatusText and LocationCode components kept; still used by
StorageTab, PlacementStage, and guided picking.
Rejected: showing the count in the provenance footer; the chips row keeps
it visible next to the other card attributes.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: no component tests exist for this panel (logic-only test
convention); verified via tsc and biome only.
